# Helper Functions and Constants

```{r helper-functions}
# "not in" operator
`%notin%` <- Negate(`%in%`)

# Indicators excluded from main Tables 1–2 and Figures 1–3 only
exclude_indicators_main <- c("Protective food consumption", "Unhealthy food consumption")

# Column / row ordering vectors
col_order <- c("country", "M49_code", "ISO3", "indicator", "year", "value", "unit")
row_order <- c("country", "year", "variable_order")

# CAGR -----------------------------------------------------------------------
calculate_cagr <- function(start_value, start_year, end_value, end_year) {
  if (start_year == end_year || is.na(start_value) || is.na(end_value)) return(NA_real_)
  if (start_value <= 0 || end_value <= 0) return(NA_real_)
  ((end_value / start_value)^(1 / (end_year - start_year)) - 1) * 100
}

# Accelerated CAGR to reach a target ----------------------------------------
calculate_accelerated_cagr <- function(start_value, start_year, target_value, target_year) {
  if (start_year == target_year || is.na(start_value) || is.na(target_value)) return(NA_real_)
  if (start_value <= 0 || target_value <= 0) return(NA_real_)
  ((target_value / start_value)^(1 / (target_year - start_year)) - 1) * 100
}

# Exponential moving average -------------------------------------------------
calculate_ema <- function(data, alpha = 0.5) {
  data %>%
    arrange(year) %>%
    mutate(
      ema_value = value[1],
      ema_value = accumulate(value[-1],
                             ~ alpha * .y + (1 - alpha) * .x,
                             .init = value[1])
    ) %>%
    pull(ema_value) %>%
    last()
}

# Save GT tables as HTML + PNG + PDF + DOCX ----------------------------------
save_table_as_html_png_pdf <- function(gt_table, filename_base,
                                       vwidth = 2400, vheight = 1600, zoom = 3) {
  gtsave(gt_table, file.path(figtab_out, paste0(filename_base, ".html")))
  gtsave(gt_table, file.path(figtab_out, paste0(filename_base, ".png")),
         vwidth = vwidth, vheight = vheight, zoom = zoom)
  gtsave(gt_table, file.path(figtab_out, paste0(filename_base, ".docx")))
  Sys.sleep(2)
  img <- image_read(file.path(figtab_out, paste0(filename_base, ".png")))
  image_write(img,
              path    = file.path(figtab_out, paste0(filename_base, ".pdf")),
              format  = "pdf",
              density = "300x300")
  cat(paste0("✓ ", filename_base, " saved in HTML, PNG, PDF, and DOCX formats\n"))
}
```

```{r table1, results='asis'}
    benchmark_Upper_middle_income   = md("*Upper middle income*"),

                          benchmark_Upper_middle_income, benchmark_High_income)) %>%
  cols_align(align = "center", columns = everything()) %>%
  tab_style(style = list(cell_fill(color = "#f8f9fa"), cell_text(weight = "bold")),
            locations = cells_row_groups()) %>%
  tab_source_note(source_note = md(
```

## Table 2 – Global Means

```{r table2}
global_means_t2 <- country_distances_df %>%
  group_by(short_label) %>%
  summarise(global_mean = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

distance_data_t2 <- mean_benchmark_distances %>%
  filter(group_type == "Global") %>%
  select(short_label, mean_dir_abs_distance_to_target, mean_dir_abs_distance_to_global)

table2 <- final_table %>%
  filter(!short_label %in% exclude_indicators_main) %>%
  left_join(global_means_t2,   by = "short_label") %>%
  left_join(distance_data_t2,  by = "short_label") %>%
  mutate(theme = ifelse(theme == "Environment, natural resources, and production",
                        "Environment, Natural Resources, and Production", theme)) %>%
  select(theme, short_label, unit, target, benchmark_Global,
         global_mean, mean_dir_abs_distance_to_target, mean_dir_abs_distance_to_global) %>%
  arrange(theme, short_label) %>%
  gt(groupname_col = "theme") %>%
  opt_table_font(font = "sans-serif", size = px(24)) %>%
  tab_header(
    title    = md("**Table 2. Global Means to Global Target and Benchmark, By Indicator**"),
    subtitle = md("*Directional distances: positive = global mean above target/benchmark.*")
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = where(is.numeric), decimals = 1) %>%
  fmt_missing(columns = everything(), missing_text = "-") %>%
  cols_label(
    short_label                      = md("**Indicator**"),
    unit                             = md("**Unit**"),
    target                           = md("**Global Target**"),
    benchmark_Global                 = md("**Global Benchmark**"),
    global_mean                      = md("**Global Mean**"),
    mean_dir_abs_distance_to_target  = md("**Distance to Global Target**"),
    mean_dir_abs_distance_to_global  = md("**Distance to Global Benchmark**")
  ) %>%
  cols_align(align = "center", columns = everything()) %>%
  tab_style(style = list(cell_fill(color = "#f8f9fa"), cell_text(weight = "bold")),
            locations = cells_row_groups())

save_table_as_html_png_pdf(table2, filename_base = "Table2")
gtsave(table2, filename = "Table2.docx")
cat("✓ Table 2 saved\n")
```

# Part 2 – Main Figures

```{r figure-dimensions}
STD_WIDTH  <- 10
STD_HEIGHT <- 12
STD_DPI    <- 300
```

## Figure 1 – Country Progress Toward 2030 Targets

```{r figure1, fig.cap="Figure 1. Number of Countries by Progress Toward 2030 Target, by Challenge Category and Theme"}
classified_2030_filtered <- classified_2030 %>%
  filter(!short_label %in% c(exclude_indicators_main, "Share of agriculture in GDP"))

challenge_levels <- c("On target or target met", "Moderate progress",
                       "Marginal progress", "Stagnation", "Regression", "Insufficient data")

challenge_summary_2030 <- classified_2030_filtered %>%
  filter(!is.na(challenge_category)) %>%
  mutate(
    theme = case_when(
      theme == "Environment, natural resources, and production" ~ "Environment, Natural Resources, and Production",
      TRUE ~ theme),
    challenge_category = factor(challenge_category, levels = challenge_levels)
  ) %>%
  group_by(theme, short_label, challenge_category) %>%
  summarise(n_countries = n(), .groups = "drop")

# Pad to 197 countries per indicator
totals_2030 <- challenge_summary_2030 %>%
  group_by(theme, short_label) %>%
  summarise(current_total = sum(n_countries), .groups = "drop")

pad_insufficient <- totals_2030 %>%
  filter(current_total < 197) %>%
  mutate(n_countries = 197 - current_total,
         challenge_category = factor("Insufficient data", levels = challenge_levels)) %>%
  select(theme, short_label, challenge_category, n_countries)

challenge_summary_2030 <- bind_rows(challenge_summary_2030, pad_insufficient) %>%
  mutate(challenge_category = factor(challenge_category, levels = challenge_levels))

# Ordering within themes
ordering_2030 <- challenge_summary_2030 %>%
  group_by(theme, short_label) %>%
  slice_max(n_countries, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(category_priority = case_when(
    challenge_category == "On target or target met" ~ 6,
    challenge_category == "Moderate progress"       ~ 5,
    challenge_category == "Marginal progress"        ~ 4,
    challenge_category == "Stagnation"              ~ 3,
    challenge_category == "Regression"              ~ 2,
    TRUE                                            ~ 1
  )) %>%
  summarise(dominant_category = first(challenge_category),
            category_priority = first(category_priority), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(
    challenge_summary_2030 %>%
      group_by(theme, short_label) %>%
      summarise(prop_on_target = sum(n_countries[challenge_category == "On target or target met"],
                                     na.rm = TRUE) / sum(n_countries), .groups = "drop"),
    by = c("theme", "short_label")
  )

challenge_summary_2030 <- challenge_summary_2030 %>%
  left_join(ordering_2030, by = c("theme", "short_label")) %>%
  group_by(theme) %>%
  mutate(order_within_theme = category_priority + prop_on_target / 1000) %>%
  ungroup()

custom_palette <- c(
  "On target or target met" = "#41AB5D",
  "Moderate progress"       = "#A1DAB4",
  "Marginal progress"        = "#41B6C4",
  "Stagnation"              = "#225EA8",
  "Regression"              = "#08306B",
  "Insufficient data"       = "#969696"
)

p_fig1 <- ggplot(challenge_summary_2030,
                 aes(y = reorder(short_label, desc(order_within_theme)),
                     x = n_countries, fill = challenge_category)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE), width = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = custom_palette) +
  facet_grid(theme ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y", switch = "y") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.y        = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x        = element_text(size = 9),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
    strip.placement    = "outside",
    strip.text.y.left  = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 1, face = "bold", size = 8),
    legend.position    = "right",
    legend.title       = element_blank(),
    plot.title         = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
    plot.subtitle      = element_text(size = 8)
  ) +
  labs(
    title    = str_wrap("Figure 1. Number of Countries by Progress Toward 2030 Target, by Challenge Category and Theme", width = 80),
    subtitle = str_wrap("Categories based on progress ratio: ≥0.95 = On target, 0.50–0.95 = Moderate, 0.10–0.50 = Marginal, 0–0.10 = Stagnation, <0 = Regression.", width = 120),
    y = NULL, x = "Number of Countries"
  )

print(p_fig1)

png(file.path(figtab_out, "Figure_1.png"), width = STD_WIDTH, height = STD_HEIGHT, unit = "in", res = STD_DPI)
print(p_fig1)
dev.off()
pdf(file.path(figtab_out, "Figure_1.pdf"), width = STD_WIDTH, height = STD_HEIGHT)
print(p_fig1)
dev.off()
cat("✓ Figure 1 saved\n")
```

## Supplementary Tables 2–4 – Benchmark Contributors

```{r benchmark-contributors}
identify_contributors <- function(data, group_vars) {
  data %>%
    group_by(across(all_of(c(group_vars, "short_label")))) %>%
    mutate(
      threshold_80 = quantile(value, 0.8, na.rm = TRUE),
      threshold_20 = quantile(value, 0.2, na.rm = TRUE),
      contributes  = case_when(
        first(desirable_direction) ==  1 & value >= threshold_80 ~ TRUE,
        first(desirable_direction) == -1 & value <= threshold_20 ~ TRUE,
        TRUE ~ FALSE
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(contributes) %>%
    summarise(
      contributing_countries = list(country),
      contributing_values    = list(value),
      n_countries = n(),
      milestone   = case_when(
        first(desirable_direction) ==  1 ~ mean(value[value >= first(threshold_80)], na.rm = TRUE),
        first(desirable_direction) == -1 ~ mean(value[value <= first(threshold_20)], na.rm = TRUE),
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      ),
      theme               = first(theme),
      desirable_direction = first(desirable_direction),
      percentile_used     = ifelse(first(desirable_direction) == 1,
                                   "Mean Top 20% (80th percentile)",
                                   "Mean Bottom 20% (20th percentile)"),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    left_join(
      data %>%
        group_by(across(all_of(c(group_vars, "short_label")))) %>%
        summarise(total_countries = n(), .groups = "drop"),
      by = c(group_vars, "short_label")
    ) %>%
    left_join(
      data %>%
        group_by(across(all_of(c(group_vars, "short_label")))) %>%
        summarise(year_range = paste0(min(year, na.rm = TRUE), "-", max(year, na.rm = TRUE)),
                  .groups = "drop"),
      by = c(group_vars, "short_label")
    )
}

contributors_global <- identify_contributors(latest_data, group_vars = c()) %>%
  mutate(group_value = "Global") %>% filter(short_label != "aginGDP")
contributors_region <- identify_contributors(latest_data, group_vars = "UN Continental Region") %>%
  rename(group_value = `UN Continental Region`)
contributors_income <- identify_contributors(latest_data, group_vars = "income_group") %>%
  rename(group_value = income_group)

cat("Contributors – Global:", nrow(contributors_global), "indicators |",
    "Regional:", nrow(contributors_region), "| Income:", nrow(contributors_income), "\n")
```

```{r build-contributor-display}
# Shared helper to format country-value list
format_country_values <- function(countries, values) {
  if (length(countries) == 0) return("No countries")
  sorted  <- order(values, decreasing = TRUE)
  countries <- countries[sorted]; values <- values[sorted]
  paste(paste0(countries, " (", round(values, 1), ")"), collapse = ", ")
}

add_display_col <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(countries_display = map2_chr(contributing_countries, contributing_values,
                                         format_country_values)) %>%
    left_join(analysis_data %>% select(short_label, unit) %>% distinct() %>%
                group_by(short_label) %>% slice_head(n = 1) %>% ungroup(),
              by = "short_label") %>%
    mutate(theme = case_when(
      theme == "Environment, natural resources, and production" ~
        "Environment, Natural Resources, and Production",
      TRUE ~ theme
    ))
}

global_data_contrib  <- add_display_col(contributors_global)
regional_data_contrib <- add_display_col(contributors_region)
income_data_contrib   <- add_display_col(contributors_income) %>%
  filter(!is.na(group_value)) %>%
  mutate(group_value = factor(group_value, levels = c("Low income", "Lower middle income",
                                                       "Upper middle income", "High income"))) %>%
  arrange(theme, short_label, group_value) %>%
  mutate(group_value = as.character(group_value))
```

```{r supp-table2}
make_contributor_gt <- function(data, title_text, group_col_label = NULL) {
  col_spec <- list(
    short_label        = "Indicator", unit = "Unit",
    milestone          = "Benchmark Value",
    n_countries        = "# Contributing Countries",
    total_countries    = "Total # with Data",
    year_range         = "Year Range",
    percentile_used    = "Method",
    countries_display  = "Contributing Countries (Values)"
  )
  if (!is.null(group_col_label)) col_spec[["group_value"]] <- group_col_label

  gt_tbl <- data %>%
    select(theme, short_label, unit, any_of("group_value"), milestone,
           n_countries, total_countries, year_range, percentile_used, countries_display) %>%
    arrange(theme, short_label) %>%
    gt(groupname_col = "theme") %>%
    opt_table_font(font = "sans-serif", size = px(24)) %>%
    tab_header(title = md(title_text)) %>%
    fmt_number(columns = milestone, decimals = 1) %>%
    fmt_missing(columns = everything(), missing_text = "-") %>%
    cols_label(.list = col_spec) %>%
    cols_width(short_label ~ px(160), unit ~ px(120), milestone ~ px(130),
               n_countries ~ px(140), total_countries ~ px(140),
               year_range ~ px(110), percentile_used ~ px(200),
               countries_display ~ px(600)) %>%
    tab_style(style = list(cell_fill(color = "#f8f9fa"), cell_text(weight = "bold")),
              locations = cells_column_labels()) %>%
    tab_style(style = list(cell_fill(color = "#f8f9fa"), cell_text(weight = "bold")),
              locations = cells_row_groups()) %>%
    tab_style(style = cell_text(whitespace = "normal"),
              locations = cells_body(columns = countries_display)) %>%
    tab_style(style = cell_text(align = "left"), locations = cells_title(groups = "title")) %>%
    tab_options(
      table.border.top.width = px(0), table.border.bottom.width = px(0),
      heading.border.bottom.width = px(0), column_labels.border.top.width = px(0),
      column_labels.border.bottom.width = px(1), row_group.border.top.width = px(0),
      row_group.border.bottom.width = px(0), table_body.border.bottom.width = px(0),
      table_body.hlines.width = px(1), table_body.vlines.width = px(0),
      row_group.background.color = "#f8f9fa", column_labels.background.color = "#f8f9fa",
      heading.background.color = "white", heading.title.font.size = px(36),
      column_labels.font.size = px(28), table.font.size = px(24),
      data_row.padding = px(4), column_labels.padding = px(4),
      table.margin.left = px(0), table.margin.right = px(0)
    )
  gt_tbl
}

cat("✓ Supplementary Table 2 saved\n")
```

```{r supp-table5}
prepare_indicator_data <- function(indicator_data) {
  indicator_data %>%
    select(short_label, unit, theme, desirable_direction) %>%
    distinct() %>% group_by(short_label) %>% slice_head(n = 1) %>% ungroup()
}

create_distance_gt <- function(data, title_text, subtitle_text, footnote_text,
                                value_cols, pivot_col = NULL,
                                col_labels = list()) {
  data %>%
    gt(groupname_col = "theme") %>%
    tab_header(title = title_text, subtitle = subtitle_text) %>%
    fmt_number(columns = all_of(value_cols), decimals = 1) %>%
    fmt_missing(columns = everything(), missing_text = "-") %>%
    cols_label(.list = col_labels) %>%
    tab_style(style = list(cell_fill(color = "#f8f9fa"), cell_text(weight = "bold")),
              locations = cells_column_labels()) %>%
    tab_style(style = list(cell_fill(color = "#f8f9fa"), cell_text(weight = "bold")),
              locations = cells_row_groups()) %>%
    tab_style(style = cell_text(align = "left"),
              locations = cells_title(groups = c("title", "subtitle"))) %>%
    tab_footnote(footnote = md(footnote_text),
                 locations = cells_title(groups = "subtitle")) %>%
    tab_options(
      table.border.top.width = px(0), table.border.bottom.width = px(0),
      heading.border.bottom.width = px(0), column_labels.border.top.width = px(0),
      column_labels.border.bottom.width = px(1), row_group.border.top.width = px(0),
      row_group.border.bottom.width = px(0), table_body.border.bottom.width = px(0),
      table_body.hlines.width = px(1), table_body.vlines.width = px(0),
      row_group.background.color = "#f8f9fa", column_labels.background.color = "#f8f9fa",
      heading.background.color = "white", heading.title.font.size = px(36),
      heading.subtitle.font.size = px(28), column_labels.font.size = px(28),
      table.font.size = px(24), data_row.padding = px(4),
      column_labels.padding = px(4), table.margin.left = px(0), table.margin.right = px(0)
    )
}
```

## Supplementary Tables 6–7 – Regional Distances

```{r supp-tables-6-7}
make_regional_pivot_gt <- function(mean_distances_data, indicator_data,
                                    dist_col, title_text, subtitle_text, footnote_text,
                                    filter_fn = NULL) {
  clean_ind <- prepare_indicator_data(indicator_data)
  region_columns <- c("Africa", "Americas", "Asia", "Europe", "Oceania")

  df <- mean_distances_data %>%
    filter(group_type == "Regional") %>%
    { if (!is.null(filter_fn)) filter_fn(.) else . } %>%
    distinct(short_label, group_name, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    left_join(clean_ind, by = "short_label") %>%
    mutate(
      direction = ifelse(desirable_direction == 1, "↑", "↓"),
      theme     = ifelse(theme %in% c("environment, natural resources, and production",
                                       "Environment, natural resources, and production"),
                         "Environment, Natural Resources, and Production", theme)
    ) %>%
    group_by(theme) %>% arrange(theme, short_label) %>% ungroup() %>%
    select(theme, short_label, unit, direction, group_name, all_of(dist_col)) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = group_name, values_from = all_of(dist_col))

  for (r in setdiff(region_columns, names(df))) df[[r]] <- NA
  df <- df %>% select(theme, short_label, unit, direction, all_of(region_columns))

  df %>%
    gt(groupname_col = "theme") %>%
    tab_header(title = title_text, subtitle = subtitle_text) %>%
    fmt_number(columns = all_of(region_columns), decimals = 1) %>%
    fmt_missing(columns = everything(), missing_text = "-") %>%
    cols_label(short_label = "Indicator", unit = "Unit", direction = "Direction") %>%
    tab_style(style = list(cell_fill(color = "#f8f9fa"), cell_text(weight = "bold")),
              locations = cells_column_labels()) %>%
    tab_style(style = list(cell_fill(color = "#f8f9fa"), cell_text(weight = "bold")),
              locations = cells_row_groups()) %>%
    tab_style(style = cell_text(align = "left"),
              locations = cells_title(groups = c("title", "subtitle"))) %>%
    tab_footnote(footnote = md(footnote_text), locations = cells_title(groups = "subtitle")) %>%
    tab_options(
      table.border.top.width = px(0), table.border.bottom.width = px(0),
      heading.border.bottom.width = px(0), column_labels.border.top.width = px(0),
      column_labels.border.bottom.width = px(1), row_group.border.top.width = px(0),
      row_group.border.bottom.width = px(0), table_body.border.bottom.width = px(0),
      table_body.hlines.width = px(1), table_body.vlines.width = px(0),
      row_group.background.color = "#f8f9fa", column_labels.background.color = "#f8f9fa",
      heading.background.color = "white", heading.title.font.size = px(36),
      heading.subtitle.font.size = px(28), column_labels.font.size = px(28),
      table.font.size = px(24), data_row.padding = px(4), column_labels.padding = px(4),
      table.margin.left = px(0), table.margin.right = px(0)
    )
}
```

```{r supp-tables-10-11}
  fmt_number(columns = all_of(income_cols), decimals = 1) %>%

    locations = cells_title(groups = "subtitle")
  ) %>%
  tab_options(
```

## Supplementary Tables 12–13 – Country Counts for Regional Averages

```{r supp-tables-12-13}
make_country_count_gt <- function(ema_cagr_data, benchmarks,
                                   count_col, indicator_filter_fn,
                                   title_text, subtitle_text) {
  valid_inds <- indicator_filter_fn(benchmarks)

  regional_counts <- ema_cagr_data %>%
    filter(group_type == "Regional", short_label %in% valid_inds) %>%
    select(theme, short_label, group_name, all_of(count_col)) %>%
    mutate(theme = ifelse(theme == "Environment, natural resources, and production",
                          "Environment, Natural Resources, and Production", theme)) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = group_name, values_from = all_of(count_col), values_fill = 0) %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ ifelse(.x == 0, NA, .x))) %>%
    arrange(theme, short_label)

  regional_counts %>%
    gt(groupname_col = "theme") %>%
    opt_table_font(font = "sans-serif", size = px(24)) %>%
    tab_header(title = md(title_text), subtitle = md(subtitle_text)) %>%
    fmt_number(columns = where(is.numeric), decimals = 0) %>%
    fmt_missing(columns = everything(), missing_text = "-") %>%
    cols_label(short_label = "Indicator") %>%
    cols_width(short_label ~ px(250), everything() ~ px(100)) %>%
    tab_style(style = list(cell_fill(color = "#f8f9fa"), cell_text(weight = "bold")),
              locations = cells_column_labels()) %>%
    tab_style(style = list(cell_fill(color = "#f8f9fa"), cell_text(weight = "bold")),
              locations = cells_row_groups()) %>%
    tab_style(style = cell_text(align = "left"),
              locations = cells_title(groups = c("title", "subtitle"))) %>%
    tab_options(
      table.border.top.width = px(0), table.border.bottom.width = px(0),
      heading.border.bottom.width = px(0), column_labels.border.top.width = px(0),
      column_labels.border.bottom.width = px(1), row_group.border.top.width = px(0),
      row_group.border.bottom.width = px(0), table_body.border.bottom.width = px(0),
      table_body.hlines.width = px(1), table_body.vlines.width = px(0),
      row_group.background.color = "#f8f9fa", column_labels.background.color = "#f8f9fa",
      heading.background.color = "white", heading.title.font.size = px(36),
      heading.subtitle.font.size = px(28), column_labels.font.size = px(28),
      table.font.size = px(24), data_row.padding = px(4), column_labels.padding = px(4),
      table.margin.left = px(0), table.margin.right = px(0)
    )
}
```

## Supplementary Table 14 – Simple vs. Comprehensive Approach

```{r supp-table14}
# Simplistic trajectories (latest value, no EMA smoothing)
calculate_simplistic_trajectories <- function(data, benchmarks) {
  latest_country_data <- data %>%
    group_by(country, short_label) %>%
    arrange(desc(year)) %>% filter(!is.na(value)) %>% slice_head(n = 1) %>%
    mutate(baseline_year = year, baseline_value = value) %>% ungroup()

  latest_country_data %>%
    left_join(select(benchmarks, short_label, target, starts_with("benchmark_")),
              by = "short_label") %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      cagr_to_target_2030 = case_when(
        short_label %in% c("Fruit availability", "Vegetable availability") &
          baseline_value > target & desirable_direction == 1 ~ 0,
        short_label == "Cropland change" &
          baseline_value <= target & desirable_direction == -1 ~ 0,
        TRUE ~ calculate_accelerated_cagr(baseline_value, baseline_year, target, 2030)),
      cagr_to_global_benchmark_2030 = case_when(
        short_label %in% c("Fruit availability", "Vegetable availability") &
          baseline_value > benchmark_Global & desirable_direction == 1 ~ 0,
        short_label == "Cropland change" &
          baseline_value <= target & desirable_direction == -1 ~ 0,
        TRUE ~ calculate_accelerated_cagr(baseline_value, baseline_year, benchmark_Global, 2030)),
      cagr_to_target_2050 = case_when(
        short_label %in% c("Fruit availability", "Vegetable availability") &
          baseline_value > target & desirable_direction == 1 ~ 0,
        short_label == "Cropland change" &
          baseline_value <= target & desirable_direction == -1 ~ 0,
        TRUE ~ calculate_accelerated_cagr(baseline_value, baseline_year, target, 2050)),
      cagr_to_global_benchmark_2050 = case_when(
        short_label %in% c("Fruit availability", "Vegetable availability") &
          baseline_value > benchmark_Global & desirable_direction == 1 ~ 0,
        short_label == "Cropland change" &
          baseline_value <= target & desirable_direction == -1 ~ 0,
        TRUE ~ calculate_accelerated_cagr(baseline_value, baseline_year, benchmark_Global, 2050))
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
}

accelerated_trajectories <- calculate_simplistic_trajectories(analysis_data, final_table)

simple_global_means_t14 <- accelerated_trajectories %>%
  group_by(short_label) %>%
  summarise(
    theme = first(theme),
    mean_cagr_to_target_2030            = mean(cagr_to_target_2030,            na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_cagr_to_global_benchmark_2030  = mean(cagr_to_global_benchmark_2030,  na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_cagr_to_target_2050            = mean(cagr_to_target_2050,            na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_cagr_to_global_benchmark_2050  = mean(cagr_to_global_benchmark_2050,  na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ema_global_means_t14 <- ema_accelerated_trajectories %>%
  group_by(short_label) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_ema_cagr_to_target_2030           = mean(ema_cagr_to_target_2030,           na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_ema_cagr_to_global_benchmark_2030 = mean(ema_cagr_to_global_benchmark_2030, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_ema_cagr_to_target_2050           = mean(ema_cagr_to_target_2050,           na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_ema_cagr_to_global_benchmark_2050 = mean(ema_cagr_to_global_benchmark_2050, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

comparison_data <- simple_global_means_t14 %>%
  left_join(ema_global_means_t14, by = "short_label") %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ ifelse(is.nan(.) | is.infinite(.), NA, .)),
         diff_target_2030  = mean_ema_cagr_to_target_2030           - mean_cagr_to_target_2030,
         diff_global_2030  = mean_ema_cagr_to_global_benchmark_2030 - mean_cagr_to_global_benchmark_2030,
         diff_target_2050  = mean_ema_cagr_to_target_2050           - mean_cagr_to_target_2050,
         diff_global_2050  = mean_ema_cagr_to_global_benchmark_2050 - mean_cagr_to_global_benchmark_2050,
         theme = case_when(
           theme == "Environment, natural resources, and production" ~
             "Environment, Natural Resources, and Production",
           TRUE ~ theme)
  ) %>%
  arrange(theme, short_label)

diff_cols <- c("diff_target_2030", "diff_global_2030", "diff_target_2050", "diff_global_2050")
num_cols  <- c("mean_cagr_to_target_2030", "mean_cagr_to_global_benchmark_2030",
               "mean_ema_cagr_to_target_2030", "mean_ema_cagr_to_global_benchmark_2030",
               "diff_target_2030", "diff_global_2030",
               "mean_cagr_to_target_2050", "mean_cagr_to_global_benchmark_2050",
               "mean_ema_cagr_to_target_2050", "mean_ema_cagr_to_global_benchmark_2050",
               "diff_target_2050", "diff_global_2050")

supp_table14 <- comparison_data %>%
  gt(groupname_col = "theme") %>%
  tab_header(
    title    = md("**Supplementary Table 14. Comparison of Simple vs. Comprehensive Approach**"),
    subtitle = md("*Required CAGR (% per year) by Indicator*")
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = all_of(num_cols), decimals = 1) %>%
  fmt_missing(columns = everything(), missing_text = "-") %>%
  tab_spanner(label = "CAGR to Global Target 2030",
              columns = c(mean_cagr_to_target_2030, mean_ema_cagr_to_target_2030, diff_target_2030)) %>%
  tab_spanner(label = "CAGR to Global Benchmark 2030",
              columns = c(mean_cagr_to_global_benchmark_2030, mean_ema_cagr_to_global_benchmark_2030, diff_global_2030)) %>%
  tab_spanner(label = "CAGR to Global Target 2050",
              columns = c(mean_cagr_to_target_2050, mean_ema_cagr_to_target_2050, diff_target_2050)) %>%
  tab_spanner(label = "CAGR to Global Benchmark 2050",
              columns = c(mean_cagr_to_global_benchmark_2050, mean_ema_cagr_to_global_benchmark_2050, diff_global_2050)) %>%
  cols_label(
    short_label                          = md("**Indicator**"),
    mean_cagr_to_target_2030             = "Simple",
    mean_ema_cagr_to_target_2030         = "Comprehensive",
    diff_target_2030                     = "Diff",
    mean_cagr_to_global_benchmark_2030   = "Simple",
    mean_ema_cagr_to_global_benchmark_2030 = "Comprehensive",
    diff_global_2030                     = "Diff",
    mean_cagr_to_target_2050             = "Simple",
    mean_ema_cagr_to_target_2050         = "Comprehensive",
    diff_target_2050                     = "Diff",
    mean_cagr_to_global_benchmark_2050   = "Simple",
    mean_ema_cagr_to_global_benchmark_2050 = "Comprehensive",
    diff_global_2050                     = "Diff"
  ) %>%
  # Blue = EMA requires less; pink = EMA requires more
  tab_style(style = cell_fill(color = "#E0F3F8"),
            locations = cells_body(columns = diff_target_2030,
                                   rows = diff_target_2030 < -0.05)) %>%
  tab_style(style = cell_fill(color = "#E0F3F8"),
            locations = cells_body(columns = diff_global_2030,
                                   rows = diff_global_2030 < -0.05)) %>%
  tab_style(style = cell_fill(color = "#E0F3F8"),
            locations = cells_body(columns = diff_target_2050,
                                   rows = diff_target_2050 < -0.05)) %>%
  tab_style(style = cell_fill(color = "#E0F3F8"),
            locations = cells_body(columns = diff_global_2050,
                                   rows = diff_global_2050 < -0.05)) %>%
  tab_style(style = cell_fill(color = "#FEE0D2"),
            locations = cells_body(columns = diff_target_2030,
                                   rows = diff_target_2030 > 0.05)) %>%
  tab_style(style = cell_fill(color = "#FEE0D2"),
            locations = cells_body(columns = diff_global_2030,
                                   rows = diff_global_2030 > 0.05)) %>%
  tab_style(style = cell_fill(color = "#FEE0D2"),
            locations = cells_body(columns = diff_target_2050,
                                   rows = diff_target_2050 > 0.05)) %>%
  tab_style(style = cell_fill(color = "#FEE0D2"),
            locations = cells_body(columns = diff_global_2050,
                                   rows = diff_global_2050 > 0.05)) %>%
  tab_style(style = list(cell_fill(color = "#f8f9fa"), cell_text(weight = "bold")),
            locations = cells_row_groups()) %>%
  tab_footnote(
    footnote = "Blue: Comprehensive requires lower CAGR than Simple. Pink: Comprehensive requires higher CAGR.",
    locations = cells_column_labels(columns = all_of(diff_cols))
  ) %>%
  tab_source_note(source_note = "CAGR = Compound Annual Growth Rate. Dash = no target or benchmark.") %>%
  tab_options(

    heading.border.bottom.width = px(0), column_labels.border.top.width = px(0),
```

## Supplementary Figure 1 – Global Means vs. Targets

```{r supp-fig1, fig.cap="Supplementary Figure 1. Comparing Current Global Means to Global Targets, by Indicator Direction"}
global_means_sf1 <- country_distances_df %>%
  group_by(short_label) %>%
  summarise(global_mean = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

sf1_plot_data <- final_table %>%
  filter(!is.na(target)) %>%
  select(short_label, target) %>%
  inner_join(
    analysis_data %>% select(short_label, unit, desirable_direction, theme) %>%
      distinct() %>% group_by(short_label) %>% slice_head(n = 1) %>% ungroup(),
    by = "short_label"
  ) %>%
  inner_join(global_means_sf1, by = "short_label") %>%
  mutate(
    theme = ifelse(theme == "Environment, natural resources, and production",
                   "Environment, Natural Resources, and Production", theme),
    direction_group    = ifelse(desirable_direction == 1,
                                "Higher Values Are Better", "Lower Values Are Better"),
    indicator_label    = paste0(short_label, " (", unit, ")"),
    target_met         = case_when(
      desirable_direction ==  1 & global_mean >= target ~ TRUE,
      desirable_direction == -1 & global_mean <= target ~ TRUE,
      TRUE ~ FALSE),
    abs_distance       = abs(global_mean - target),
    segment_start      = pmin(global_mean, target),
    segment_end        = pmax(global_mean, target)
  ) %>%
  arrange(direction_group, theme, desc(abs_distance)) %>%
  mutate(indicator_label = factor(indicator_label, levels = rev(unique(indicator_label))),
         direction_group  = factor(direction_group,
                                   levels = c("Higher Values Are Better", "Lower Values Are Better")))

sf1_long <- sf1_plot_data %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(global_mean, target), names_to = "value_type", values_to = "value")

p_supp1 <- ggplot() +
  geom_segment(data = sf1_plot_data,
               aes(x = segment_start, xend = segment_end,
                   y = indicator_label, yend = indicator_label),
               color = "gray60", linewidth = 1.0) +
  geom_point(data = sf1_long,
             aes(x = value, y = indicator_label,
                 color = value_type, shape = value_type), size = 4.0) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma(accuracy = 0.1)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(global_mean = "#1e88e5", target = "#000000"),
                     labels = c(global_mean = "Global Mean", target = "Target")) %>%
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(global_mean = 16, target = 18),
                     labels = c(global_mean = "Global Mean", target = "Target")) +
  facet_grid(theme ~ direction_group, scales = "free", space = "free_y",
             labeller = labeller(theme = label_wrap_gen(12))) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.y       = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x       = element_text(size = 9),
    strip.text.y      = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold", angle = 0, hjust = 0),
    strip.text.x      = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold", color = "white"),
    strip.background.x= element_rect(fill = "#37474f", color = NA),
    panel.border      = element_rect(color = "gray80", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5),
    panel.spacing.x   = unit(0.8, "lines"),
    legend.position   = "bottom", legend.title = element_blank(),
    plot.title        = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    plot.subtitle     = element_text(size = 9)
  ) +
  labs(
    title    = str_wrap("Supplementary Figure 1. Comparing Current Global Means to Global Targets, by Indicator Direction", 100),
    subtitle = str_wrap("Indicators separated by desirable direction. Green lines indicate targets already met.", 120),
    x = "Value", y = NULL
  )

print(p_supp1)
ggsave(file.path(figtab_out, "Supplementary_Figure_1.png"), p_supp1,
       width = STD_WIDTH * 1.2, height = STD_HEIGHT, dpi = STD_DPI, bg = "white")

       width = STD_WIDTH * 1.2, height = STD_HEIGHT, bg = "white")
cat("✓ Supplementary Figure 1 saved\n")
```

```{r supp-fig3, fig.cap="Supplementary Figure 3. Number of Countries by Progress Toward 2050 Target, by Challenge Category and Theme"}
    challenge_category = factor(challenge_category, levels = challenge_levels_2050)
  ) %>%
  group_by(theme, short_label, challenge_category) %>%
  summarise(n_countries = n(), .groups = "drop")

totals_2050 <- challenge_summary_2050 %>%
  group_by(theme, short_label) %>% summarise(current_total = sum(n_countries), .groups = "drop")

pad_insuff_2050 <- totals_2050 %>%
  filter(current_total < 197) %>%
  mutate(n_countries = 197 - current_total,
         challenge_category = factor("Insufficient data", levels = challenge_levels_2050)) %>%
  select(theme, short_label, challenge_category, n_countries)

challenge_summary_2050 <- bind_rows(challenge_summary_2050, pad_insuff_2050) %>%
  mutate(challenge_category = factor(challenge_category, levels = challenge_levels_2050))

ordering_2050 <- challenge_summary_2050 %>%
  group_by(theme, short_label) %>%
  slice_max(n_countries, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(category_priority = case_when(
    challenge_category == "On target or target met" ~ 6,
    challenge_category == "Moderate progress"       ~ 5,
    challenge_category == "Marginal progress"        ~ 4,
    challenge_category == "Stagnation"              ~ 3,
    challenge_category == "Regression"              ~ 2,
    TRUE                                            ~ 1
  )) %>%
  summarise(dominant_category = first(challenge_category),
            category_priority = first(category_priority), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(
    challenge_summary_2050 %>%
      group_by(theme, short_label) %>%
      summarise(prop_on_target = sum(n_countries[challenge_category == "On target or target met"],
                                     na.rm = TRUE) / sum(n_countries), .groups = "drop"),
    by = c("theme", "short_label")
  )

challenge_summary_2050 <- challenge_summary_2050 %>%
  left_join(ordering_2050, by = c("theme", "short_label")) %>%
  group_by(theme) %>%
  mutate(order_within_theme = category_priority + prop_on_target / 1000) %>%
  ungroup()

custom_palette_2050 <- c(
  "On target or target met" = "#41AB5D", "Moderate progress"  = "#A1DAB4",
  "Marginal progress"        = "#41B6C4", "Stagnation"         = "#225EA8",
  "Regression"              = "#08306B", "Insufficient data"  = "#969696"
)

p_supp3 <- ggplot(challenge_summary_2050,
                  aes(y = reorder(short_label, desc(order_within_theme)),
                      x = n_countries, fill = challenge_category)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE), width = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = custom_palette_2050) +
  facet_grid(theme ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y", switch = "y") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.y        = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x        = element_text(size = 9),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.placement    = "outside",
    strip.text.y.left  = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 1, face = "bold", size = 8),
    legend.position    = "right", legend.title = element_blank(),
    plot.title         = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
    plot.subtitle      = element_text(size = 8)
  ) +
  labs(
    title    = str_wrap("Supplementary Figure 3. Number of Countries by Progress Toward 2050 Target, by Challenge Category and Theme", 80),
    subtitle = str_wrap("Categories based on progress ratio: ≥0.95 = On target, 0.50–0.95 = Moderate, 0.10–0.50 = Marginal, 0–0.10 = Stagnation, <0 = Regression.", 120),
    y = NULL, x = "Number of Countries"
  )

print(p_supp3)
ggsave(file.path(figtab_out, "Supplementary_Figure_3.png"), p_supp3,
       width = STD_WIDTH, height = STD_HEIGHT, dpi = STD_DPI, bg = "white")
ggsave(file.path(figtab_out, "Supplementary_Figure_3.pdf"), p_supp3,
       width = STD_WIDTH, height = STD_HEIGHT, bg = "white")
cat("✓ Supplementary Figure 3 saved\n")
```

## Supplementary Figure 4 - Trends over time
```{r, warning = FALSE, messages = FALSE, cache = TRUE}
# Regress each variable on time to get average linear trend

# Indicators that must be excluded from time trend regression:
    oneyear <- c("Fisheries health index")
    surveyindicators <- c("All 5 food groups", "Child labor", 
                          "Female landholdings", 
                          "Minimum dietary diversity, child",                   
                          "Minimum dietary diversity, women", "NCD-Protect",
                          "NCD-Risk", "Reduced coping strategies",
                          "Social protection adequacy", 
                          "Social protection coverage", 
                          "Soft drink consumption", 
                          "Zero fruits or vegetables, adult", 
                          "Zero fruits or vegetables, child",
                          "Protective foods",
                          "Unhealthy foods")
  
  # Set up data
    data <- FSCI_2025 %>%
      # Remove categorical indicators
      filter(!(unit == "categorical")) %>%
      # Remove indicators with only one year of data
      filter(!(short_label %in% oneyear)) %>%
      # Remove survey data
      filter(!(short_label %in% surveyindicators)) %>%
      select(country, short_label, year, value, indicator_order, 
             desirable_direction, theme, weight, 
             FSCI_region, income_group) %>%
      filter(!(is.na(value))) %>%
      mutate(value = as.numeric(value),
             country = as.character(country)) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      filter(!(is.na(value)))
    
  # Now normalize the data
    data <- data %>%
      group_by(short_label) %>%
      mutate(normvalue = (value - min(value)) / (max(value) - min(value)),
             normvalue = normvalue * 100) %>%
      ungroup() 
    
    data$short_label <- factor(data$short_label)
    data$country <- factor(data$country)
    data <- droplevels(data)
    
    # Initialize an empty list to store results
      results_list <- list()

    # Iterate over unique levels of short_label
      for (i in unique(data$short_label)) {
        dat <- filter(data, short_label == i)
        
        # Check if there are enough data points for the model
          print(i)

          model <- lm(normvalue ~ year + FSCI_region, data = dat, weights = weight)
          result <- broom::tidy(model)
          result <- result

          # Add 95% confidence interval to the result
          conf_int <- broom::confint_tidy(model)

          result <- cbind(result, conf_int)
          
          # Add short_label to the result
          result$short_label <- i
          
          # Add result to list
          results_list[[i]] <- result 
          }
    
    # Combine results into a single data frame
    all_results <- do.call(rbind, results_list)
    
# Export table of full results
    
    regress_tbl <- all_results %>%
      filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
      filter(!str_detect(term, "^FSCI_region")) %>%
      select(-c(statistic, term)) %>%
      mutate(across(1:5, round, 5)) %>%
      relocate(short_label, .before = estimate)
    
    # Add indicator order to sort
    data2 <- data[, c("short_label", "indicator_order", "desirable_direction")]
    data2 <- data2 %>% unique()
    regress_tbl <- left_join(regress_tbl, data2, by = ("Indicator" = "short_label"))
    regress_tbl <- regress_tbl %>% arrange(indicator_order) %>%
      select(-c(indicator_order))
    
    # Name the columns nicely
    col_names <- c( "Indicator", "Coef.", "SE", "p val.", "95% Conf. Int.", "merge", "Desirable direction")
    colnames(regress_tbl) <- col_names
    
# Remove the intercepts
    all_results2 <- all_results %>%
      filter(!str_detect(term, "^FSCI_region")) %>%
      filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
      rename(pval = "p.value")
    
# Add stars for p-value
    all_results2 <- all_results2 %>%
      mutate(star = case_when(pval < 0.001 ~ "***",
                              pval >= 0.001 & pval < 0.01 ~ "**",
                              pval >= 0.01 & pval < 0.05 ~ "*",
                              pval >= 0.05 ~ "")) %>%
      select(short_label, estimate, conf.low, conf.high, star, pval) %>%
      mutate(across(2:4, round, 3)) # This rounding step is consequential for the results - important to make a choice about how many digits to keep to "round to zero"
    
    # Merge in the theme and variable order 
    data2 <- data[, c("short_label", "indicator_order", "theme", "desirable_direction")]
    data2 <- data2 %>% unique()
    all_results2$short_label <- factor(all_results2$short_label)
    all_results2 <- left_join(all_results2, data2, by = c("short_label"))
    # Add a variable to indicate whether the change is flat, in the right direction, or in the wrong direction
    all_results2 <- all_results2 %>%
      mutate(Progress = case_when(pval >= 0.05 ~ "No change",
                                  desirable_direction == 1 & pval < 0.05 & estimate > 0 ~ "Desirable change",
                                  desirable_direction == -1 & pval < 0.05 & estimate < 0 ~ "Desirable change",
                                  desirable_direction == 1 & pval < 0.05 & estimate < 0 ~ "Undesirable change",
                                  desirable_direction == -1 & pval < 0.05 & estimate > 0 ~ "Undesirable change",
                                  desirable_direction == 1 & pval <0.05 & estimate == 0 ~ "No change",
                                  desirable_direction == -1 & pval <0.05 & estimate == 0 ~ "No change",
                                  TRUE ~ "No change"),
             Progress = as.factor(Progress))


# Plot the estimates
  p1 <- all_results2 %>%
       filter(estimate < 11) %>%
      ggplot(., aes(y = fct_reorder(short_label, desc(estimate)), x = estimate)) + 
      geom_point(aes(color = Progress)) +
      geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high, color = Progress), width = 0.1) +
      geom_text(aes(label = star, x = conf.high, color = Progress), hjust = -.1) +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("forestgreen","gray85",  "darkred")) +
      scale_y_discrete(limits=rev) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 0) +
      theme_classic() +
      labs(y = "",
           x = "Average percent change per year (95% Confidence Interval)",
           caption = "*** p< 0.001, ** p< 0.01, * p < 0.05") +
      theme(plot.caption = element_text(hjust = -0.88),
            plot.margin = unit(c(0,0,0,0), "cm"),
            legend.position = "none")

  # Now create the legend to show progress
    forlegend <- all_results2 %>%
      ggplot(., aes(y = fct_reorder(short_label, desc(estimate)), x = 1)) +
      geom_point(aes(color = Progress), size = 4) +
      scale_color_manual(values = c( "forestgreen","gray85", "darkred"),
                         guide = guide_legend()) +
      scale_y_discrete(limits=rev) +
      scale_x_discrete(c(1,1)) +
      theme_classic() +
      theme(legend.text = element_text(size=12),
            legend.title.align = 0,
            legend.position = "right", 
            legend.justification = "left",
            legend.direction = "horizontal",
            legend.title = element_text(size=12),
            plot.margin = unit(c(0,0,0,0), "cm"),
            legend.margin=unit(c(0,0,0,0), "cm"))
    legend <- get_legend(forlegend)

# Save the plot as .png
     png(file.path(figtab_out, "SI Figure X_Trends.png"), width = 7.5, height = 10, unit = "in", res = 300)
     cowplot::plot_grid(p1, legend, nrow = 2, rel_heights = c(22,1), align = "v")
     dev.off()
#     
# # And as PDF for journal
    pdf(file.path(figtab_out, "SI Figure X_Trends.pdf"), width = 7.5, height = 10)
    cowplot::plot_grid(p1, legend, nrow = 2, rel_heights = c(22,1), align = "v")
    dev.off()

# Clean up
  rm(legend, p1, all_results2, data2, col_names, regress_tbl, all_results, data, surveyindicators, oneyear, Indicator, i, model, conf_int)
```

# Supplementary Figures 5–49 (Individual Indicator Trajectories)

```{r trajectory-function}
# Full trajectory generation function
generate_table_consistent_trajectories <- function(analysis_data, ema_data, final_table,
                                                    ema_cagr_summaries,
                                                    indicator_name = "Fruit availability",
                                                    output_dir = figtab_out,
                                                    figure_number = 5) {
  cat("Generating trajectories for:", indicator_name, "\n")
  if (indicator_name == "Share of agriculture in GDP") { cat("Skipping\n"); return(NULL) }

  region_col     <- "UN Continental Region"
  indicator_data <- analysis_data %>% filter(short_label == indicator_name)
  target_info    <- final_table    %>% filter(short_label == indicator_name)
  if (nrow(indicator_data) == 0 || nrow(target_info) == 0) {
    warning("Insufficient data for: ", indicator_name); return(NULL)
  }

  theme_name          <- unique(indicator_data$theme)[1]
  unit_name           <- unique(indicator_data$unit)[1]
  desirable_direction <- if ("desirable_direction" %in% names(indicator_data)) {
    dd <- unique(indicator_data$desirable_direction); if (length(dd) && !is.na(dd[1])) dd[1] else 1
  } else 1
  is_higher_better <- desirable_direction > 0
  if (indicator_name %in% c("Cropland change", "cropland change", "Deforestation rate"))
    is_higher_better <- FALSE

  region_colors <- c(Africa = "#E41A1C", Americas = "#377EB8", Asia = "#4DAF4A",
                     Europe = "#984EA3", Oceania  = "#FF7F00")

  has_target    <- !is.na(target_info$target)
  has_benchmark <- !is.na(target_info$benchmark_Global)
  target_value  <- if (has_target)    target_info$target          else NA
  benchmark_value <- if (has_benchmark) target_info$benchmark_Global else NA
  if (indicator_name %in% c("Fruit availability", "Vegetable availability") &&
      !is.na(target_value) && target_value > 400) target_value <- 400

  table_baselines <- ema_data %>%
    filter(short_label == indicator_name) %>%
    select(country, baseline_value, baseline_year, `UN Continental Region`) %>%
    rename(region_name = `UN Continental Region`)
  if (nrow(table_baselines) == 0) { warning("No baseline data for: ", indicator_name); return(NULL) }

  regional_table_baselines <- table_baselines %>%
    group_by(region_name) %>%
    summarise(regional_baseline_value = mean(baseline_value, na.rm = TRUE),
              regional_baseline_year  = round(mean(baseline_year, na.rm = TRUE)),
              countries_in_region     = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(
      proper_target_cagr_2030 = case_when(
        is.na(target_value) | regional_baseline_value <= 0 | target_value <= 0 ~ NA_real_,
        is_higher_better & regional_baseline_value >= target_value ~ 0,
        TRUE ~ ((target_value / regional_baseline_value)^(1 / (2030 - regional_baseline_year)) - 1) * 100),
      proper_target_cagr_2050 = case_when(
        is.na(target_value) | regional_baseline_value <= 0 | target_value <= 0 ~ NA_real_,
        is_higher_better & regional_baseline_value >= target_value ~ 0,
        TRUE ~ ((target_value / regional_baseline_value)^(1 / (2050 - regional_baseline_year)) - 1) * 100),
      proper_benchmark_cagr_2030 = case_when(
        is.na(benchmark_value) | regional_baseline_value <= 0 | benchmark_value <= 0 ~ NA_real_,
        is_higher_better & regional_baseline_value >= benchmark_value ~ 0,
        TRUE ~ ((benchmark_value / regional_baseline_value)^(1 / (2030 - regional_baseline_year)) - 1) * 100),
      proper_benchmark_cagr_2050 = case_when(
        is.na(benchmark_value) | regional_baseline_value <= 0 | benchmark_value <= 0 ~ NA_real_,
        is_higher_better & regional_baseline_value >= benchmark_value ~ 0,
        TRUE ~ ((benchmark_value / regional_baseline_value)^(1 / (2050 - regional_baseline_year)) - 1) * 100)
    )

  table_cagr_values <- ema_cagr_summaries %>%
    filter(group_type == "Regional", short_label == indicator_name) %>%
    select(region_name = group_name,
           avg_cagr_2030 = mean_ema_cagr_to_target_2030,
           avg_cagr_2050 = mean_ema_cagr_to_target_2050,
           avg_benchmark_cagr_2030 = mean_ema_cagr_to_global_benchmark_2030,
           avg_benchmark_cagr_2050 = mean_ema_cagr_to_global_benchmark_2050)

  projection_setup <- regional_table_baselines %>%
    left_join(table_cagr_values, by = "region_name")

  can_plot_target    <- has_target    && sum(!is.na(projection_setup$proper_target_cagr_2030))    > 0
  can_plot_benchmark <- has_benchmark && sum(!is.na(projection_setup$proper_benchmark_cagr_2030)) > 0
  if (!can_plot_target && !can_plot_benchmark) { warning("No valid projections for: ", indicator_name); return(NULL) }

  # Indicators that suppress historical lines
  suppress_historical <- c("All 5 food groups", "Minimum dietary diversity, child",
                           "Minimum dietary diversity, women", "NCD-Protect", "NCD-Risk",
                           "Protective food consumption", "Unhealthy food consumption",
                           "Soft drink consumption", "Zero fruits or vegetables, adult",
                           "Zero fruits or vegetables, child", "Fisheries health index",
                           "Child labor", "Female landholdings", "Social protection adequacy",
                           "Social protection coverage", "Reduced coping strategies")

  # Historical lines (regional averages up to baseline)
  historical_data <- indicator_data %>%
    select(country, year, value, !!sym(region_col)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(value)) %>%
    rename(region_name = !!sym(region_col)) %>%
    group_by(region_name, year) %>%
    summarise(avg_value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    left_join(select(regional_table_baselines, region_name, regional_baseline_year),
              by = "region_name") %>%
    filter(year <= regional_baseline_year) %>%
    select(-regional_baseline_year) %>%
    mutate(type = "Historical")

  baseline_pts <- regional_table_baselines %>%
    select(region_name, regional_baseline_value, regional_baseline_year) %>%
    rename(avg_value = regional_baseline_value, year = regional_baseline_year) %>%
    mutate(type = "Baseline_Connection")

  # Build projection trajectories
  projection_data <- pmap_dfr(
    list(projection_setup$region_name,
         projection_setup$regional_baseline_value,
         projection_setup$regional_baseline_year,
         projection_setup$proper_target_cagr_2030,
         projection_setup$proper_target_cagr_2050,
         projection_setup$proper_benchmark_cagr_2030,
         projection_setup$proper_benchmark_cagr_2050),
    function(rn, bv, by, tc30, tc50, bc30, bc50) {
      rows <- list()
      make_proj <- function(cagr, end_year, type_label) {
        if (is.na(cagr)) return(NULL)
        yrs <- seq(by, end_year)
        data.frame(region_name = rn, year = yrs,
                   avg_value = bv * (1 + cagr / 100)^(yrs - by), type = type_label)
      }
      if (can_plot_target) {
        rows <- c(rows, list(make_proj(tc30, 2030, "EMA-TARGET-2030"),
                             make_proj(tc50, 2050, "EMA-TARGET-2050")))
      }
      if (can_plot_benchmark) {
        rows <- c(rows, list(make_proj(bc30, 2030, "EMA-BENCHMARK-2030"),
                             make_proj(bc50, 2050, "EMA-BENCHMARK-2050")))
      }
      bind_rows(rows)
    }
  )
  if (nrow(projection_data) == 0) { warning("No projections for: ", indicator_name); return(NULL) }

  all_traj <- bind_rows(historical_data, baseline_pts, projection_data)
  hist_lines <- if (indicator_name %in% suppress_historical) baseline_pts
                else filter(all_traj, type %in% c("Historical", "Baseline_Connection"))

  y_all   <- c(all_traj$avg_value,
               if (!is.na(target_value))    target_value    else NULL,
               if (!is.na(benchmark_value)) benchmark_value else NULL)
  y_range <- diff(range(y_all, na.rm = TRUE))
  y_min   <- max(0, min(y_all, na.rm = TRUE) - 0.05 * y_range)
  y_max   <- max(y_all, na.rm = TRUE) + 0.05 * y_range
  if (min(y_all, na.rm = TRUE) < 0) y_min <- min(y_all, na.rm = TRUE) - 0.05 * abs(min(y_all, na.rm = TRUE))

  add_letter <- function(p, l) p + annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = l,
                                             hjust = -0.5, vjust = 1.5, size = 8, fontface = "bold")

  make_panel <- function(proj_type, end_year, ref_val, ref_label, letter) {
    proj_lines <- filter(all_traj, type == proj_type)
    if (nrow(proj_lines) == 0) return(NULL)
    cagr_col <- if (grepl("TARGET", proj_type)) {
      if (end_year == 2030) "avg_cagr_2030" else "avg_cagr_2050"
    } else {
      if (end_year == 2030) "avg_benchmark_cagr_2030" else "avg_benchmark_cagr_2050"
    }
    lbl_data <- baseline_pts %>%
      left_join(table_cagr_values, by = "region_name") %>%
      filter(!is.na(.data[[cagr_col]])) %>%
      arrange(avg_value) %>%
      mutate(pos_rank = row_number(),
             offset   = (y_max - y_min) * 0.03 * ifelse(pos_rank %% 2 == 1, 1, -1),
             label_v  = avg_value + offset,
             label_t  = paste0(round(.data[[cagr_col]], 1), "%"))

    p <- ggplot() +
      geom_line(data = hist_lines, aes(x = year, y = avg_value, color = region_name), linewidth = 1) +
      geom_line(data = proj_lines, aes(x = year, y = avg_value, color = region_name),
                linewidth = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
      geom_hline(yintercept = ref_val, color = "black", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.7) +
      geom_label(data = lbl_data,
                 aes(x = year, y = label_v, color = region_name, label = label_t),
                 fill = "white", alpha = 0.9, label.size = 0.2, size = 2.5,
                 hjust = 0.5, label.padding = unit(0.15, "lines"), label.r = unit(0.1, "lines")) +
      scale_color_manual(values = region_colors, name = "Region") +
      scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(floor(min(all_traj$year) / 5) * 5, end_year, by = ifelse(end_year == 2030, 5, 10))) +
      scale_y_continuous(limits = c(y_min, y_max)) +
      coord_cartesian(xlim = c(NA, end_year + 1)) +
      labs(title    = paste0(ref_label, " ", end_year),
           subtitle = paste0(sub(".*-", "", ref_label), ": ", round(ref_val, 1), " ", unit_name),
           x = "Year", y = paste0("Value (", unit_name, ")")) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(legend.position = "right", plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
            plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
            panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "gray80"))
    add_letter(p, letter)
  }

  plots <- list()
  if (can_plot_target) {
    plots[["A"]] <- make_panel("EMA-TARGET-2030",    2030, target_value,    "Global Target",    "A")
    plots[["B"]] <- make_panel("EMA-TARGET-2050",    2050, target_value,    "Global Target",    "B")
  }
  if (can_plot_benchmark) {
    lA <- if (can_plot_target) "C" else "A"
    lB <- if (can_plot_target) "D" else "B"
    plots[[lA]] <- make_panel("EMA-BENCHMARK-2030", 2030, benchmark_value, "Global Benchmark", lA)
    plots[[lB]] <- make_panel("EMA-BENCHMARK-2050", 2050, benchmark_value, "Global Benchmark", lB)
  }
  plots <- Filter(Negate(is.null), plots)
  if (length(plots) < 2) { warning("Not enough panels for: ", indicator_name); return(NULL) }

  grid_layout <- if (length(plots) == 4) {
    (plots[["A"]] + plots[["B"]]) / (plots[["C"]] + plots[["D"]])
  } else {
    plots[[1]] / plots[[2]]
  }

  fig_title <- if (can_plot_target && can_plot_benchmark)
    paste0("Supplementary Figure ", figure_number, ". Regional Trajectories to Global Target and Benchmark to 2030 and 2050, ", indicator_name)
  else if (can_plot_target)
    paste0("Supplementary Figure ", figure_number, ". Regional Trajectories to Global Target to 2030 and 2050, ", indicator_name)
  else
    paste0("Supplementary Figure ", figure_number, ". Regional Trajectories to Global Benchmark to 2030 and 2050, ", indicator_name)

  combined_plot <- grid_layout +
    patchwork::plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
    patchwork::plot_annotation(
      title    = fig_title,
      subtitle = paste0("Unit: ", unit_name, " | Theme: ", theme_name,
                        " | ", ifelse(is_higher_better, "higher is better", "lower is better")),
      theme    = theme(plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
                       plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
    )

  fname_base <- paste0("Supplementary_Figure_", figure_number, "_",
                       gsub("[^a-zA-Z0-9]", "_", indicator_name), "_regional_trajectories")
  ggsave(file.path(output_dir, paste0(fname_base, ".png")), combined_plot,
         width = 12, height = 12, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  ggsave(file.path(output_dir, paste0(fname_base, ".pdf")), combined_plot,
         width = 12, height = 12, bg = "white")
  cat("✓ Saved:", fname_base, "\n")
  invisible(list(figure_number = figure_number, indicator_name = indicator_name))
}
```

```{r run-trajectory-figures}
all_indicators <- unique(
  final_table$short_label[!is.na(final_table$target) | !is.na(final_table$benchmark_Global)]
)

results         <- list()

for (i in seq_along(all_indicators)) {
  ind <- all_indicators[i]
  cat("Processing", i, "of", length(all_indicators), ":", ind, "as Figure", current_fig_num, "\n")
  result <- tryCatch(
    generate_table_consistent_trajectories(
      analysis_data      = analysis_data,
      ema_data           = ema_accelerated_trajectories,
      final_table        = final_table,
      ema_cagr_summaries = ema_cagr_summaries,
      indicator_name     = ind,
      output_dir         = figtab_out,
      figure_number      = current_fig_num
    ),
    error = function(e) { cat("Error:", ind, "-", e$message, "\n"); NULL }
  )
  if (!is.null(result)) { results[[ind]] <- result; current_fig_num <- current_fig_num + 1L }
}

cat("✓ Generated", length(results), "trajectory figures (Figs 5 –", current_fig_num - 1L, ")\n")
```

#### SI Table X. Regression results of time trends
```{r, warning = FALSE, messages = FALSE, cache = TRUE}
# Regress each variable on time to get average linear trend

# Indicators that must be excluded from time trend regression:
    oneyear <- c("Fisheries health index")
    surveyindicators <- c("All 5 food groups", "Child labor", 
                          "Female landholdings", 
                          "Minimum dietary diversity, child",                   
                          "Minimum dietary diversity, women", "NCD-Protect",
                          "NCD-Risk", "Reduced coping strategies",
                          "Social protection adequacy", 
                          "Social protection coverage", 
                          "Soft drink consumption", 
                          "Zero fruits or vegetables, adult", 
                          "Zero fruits or vegetables, child",
                          "Protective foods",
                          "Unhealthy foods")
  
  # Set up data
    data <- FSCI_2025 %>%
      # Remove categorical indicators
      filter(!(unit == "categorical")) %>%
      # Remove indicators with only one year of data
      filter(!(short_label %in% oneyear)) %>%
      # Remove survey data
      filter(!(short_label %in% surveyindicators)) %>%
      select(country, short_label, year, value, indicator_order, 
             desirable_direction, theme, weight, 
             FSCI_region, income_group) %>%
      filter(!(is.na(value))) %>%
      mutate(value = as.numeric(value),
             country = as.character(country)) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      filter(!(is.na(value)))
    
  # Now normalize the data
    data <- data %>%
      group_by(short_label) %>%
      mutate(normvalue = (value - min(value)) / (max(value) - min(value)),
             normvalue = normvalue * 100) %>%
      ungroup() 
    
    data$short_label <- factor(data$short_label)
    data$country <- factor(data$country)
    data <- droplevels(data)
    
    # Initialize an empty list to store results
      results_list <- list()

    # Iterate over unique levels of short_label
      for (i in unique(data$short_label)) {
        dat <- filter(data, short_label == i)
        
        # Check if there are enough data points for the model
          print(i)

          model <- lm(normvalue ~ year + FSCI_region, data = dat, weights = weight)
          result <- broom::tidy(model)
          result <- result

          # Add 95% confidence interval to the result
          conf_int <- broom::confint_tidy(model)

          result <- cbind(result, conf_int)
          
          # Add short_label to the result
          result$short_label <- i
          
          # Add result to list
          results_list[[i]] <- result 
          }
    
    # Combine results into a single data frame
    all_results <- do.call(rbind, results_list)
    
    regress_tbl <- all_results %>%
      filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
      filter(!str_detect(term, "^FSCI_region")) %>%
      select(-c(statistic, term)) %>%
      mutate(across(1:5, round, 5)) %>%
      relocate(short_label, .before = estimate)
    
    # Add indicator order to sort
    data2 <- data[, c("short_label", "indicator_order", "desirable_direction")]
    data2 <- data2 %>% unique()
    regress_tbl <- left_join(regress_tbl, data2, by = ("Indicator" = "short_label"))
    regress_tbl <- regress_tbl %>% arrange(indicator_order) %>%
      select(-c(indicator_order))
    
    # Add stars for p-value
    regress_tbl <- regress_tbl %>%
      mutate(star = case_when(p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
                              p.value >= 0.001 & p.value < 0.01 ~ "**",
                              p.value >= 0.01 & p.value < 0.05 ~ "*",
                              p.value >= 0.05 ~ "")) %>%
      mutate(across(2:6, round, 3)) %>% # This rounding step is consequential for the results - important to make a choice about how many digits to keep to "round to zero"
      relocate(star, .after = p.value)
    
  
    # Add progress column
    regress_tbl <- regress_tbl %>%
      mutate(Progress = case_when(p.value >= 0.05 ~ "No change",
                                  desirable_direction == 1 & p.value < 0.05 & estimate > 0 ~ "Desirable change",
                                  desirable_direction == -1 & p.value < 0.05 & estimate < 0 ~ "Desirable change",
                                  desirable_direction == 1 & p.value < 0.05 & estimate < 0 ~ "Undesirable change",
                                  desirable_direction == -1 & p.value < 0.05 & estimate > 0 ~ "Undesirable change",
                                  desirable_direction == 1 & p.value <0.05 & estimate == 0 ~ "No change",
                                  desirable_direction == -1 & p.value <0.05 & estimate == 0 ~ "No change",
                                  TRUE ~ "No change"),
             Progress = as.factor(Progress))
    
  # Get the sample size (countries by years) per indicator
    samplesize <- data %>%
      group_by(short_label) %>%
      summarize("N countries" = n_distinct(country),
                "Years" = min(year),
                "Years2" = max(year),
                "N years" = n_distinct(year)) %>%
      ungroup()
    regress_tbl <- left_join(regress_tbl, samplesize, by = c("short_label"))
    
    # Name the columns nicely
    col_names <- c( "Indicator", "Coef.", "SE", "p val.", "merge1", "95% Conf. Int.", "merge2", "Desirable direction", "Trend", "N Countries", "Years", "merge3", "N years")
    colnames(regress_tbl) <- col_names
    regress_tbl$Years <- as.character(regress_tbl$Years)
    regress_tbl$merge3 <- as.character(regress_tbl$merge3)
    

# Export table of full results
    
    SItable1 <- flextable::flextable(regress_tbl) %>% autofit() %>%
      set_table_properties(layout = "autofit")
        
    # Save table
      save_as_docx(SItable1, path = file.path(figtab_out, "SI Table X_Linear time trend regression.docx"), orient = "landscape")
      
# Clean up
    rm(surveyindicators, oneyear, SItable1, regress_tbl, data2, all_results, results_list, data)

```

```{r, warning = FALSE, messages = FALSE, cache = TRUE}
      for (i in unique(data$short_label)) {

        # Check if there are enough data points for the model
          model <- lm(normvalue ~ year*FSCI_region, data = dat, weights = weight)
          result <- broom::tidy(model)
          predict <- ggeffects::ggpredict(model, c("year", "FSCI_region"))

          # Add short_label to the result
          result$short_label <- i
          predict$short_label <- i

          # Add result to list
          results_list[[i]] <- result 
          predict_list[[i]] <- predict 
          }
    
    # Combine results into a single data frame
    all_results <- do.call(rbind, results_list)
    margins <- do.call(rbind, predict_list)
    
    # Bring in theme
    data2 <- data[, c("short_label", "indicator_order", "theme", "desirable_direction")]
    data2 <- data2 %>% unique()
    margins$short_label <- factor(margins$short_label)
    margins <- left_join(margins, data2, by = c("short_label"))
    # Clean up 
    margins <- margins %>%
      rename(Year = x,
             y_hat = predicted,
             SE = std.error,
             Region = group)
      
    marginsplot <- function(data, label) {
        p <- margins%>% 
          filter(margins$short_label == label) %>%
          ggplot(aes(x = as.factor(Year), y = y_hat, color = Region)) +
          geom_point(size = 1) +
          geom_line(aes(group = Region), size = 1) +
          scale_color_manual(values = region_colors) +
          guides(color = FALSE) +
          theme_classic() +
          theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(),
                axis.title.y = element_text(size = 7),
                axis.text.x = element_text(size = 5, angle = 45),
                plot.title = element_text(size = 8)) +
          labs(y = "Predicted value (% change)") +
          ggtitle(label) 
      print(p)
    }

  # Order themes
  data$theme <- ordered(data$theme, levels = c("Diets, Nutrition, and Health", "Environment, natural resources, and production", "Livelihoods, Poverty, and Equity", "Governance", "Resilience"))

# Plot per theme
  n <- 1
  for (i in levels(data$theme)) {
    df <- paste0("df_", n)  
    assign(df, data  %>%
             filter(theme == i) %>%
             mutate(short_label = as.factor(short_label)) %>%
             droplevels()) 
    ordered_indicators <- get(df)$short_label
    ind <- paste0("indicators_", n)  
    assign(ind, as.list(levels(ordered_indicators)))
    n <- n + 1
  }
    
  # Now run for all the indicators per theme
    plots_1 <- lapply(indicators_1, function(x) marginsplot(df_1, x)) 
    plots_2 <- lapply(indicators_2, function(x) marginsplot(df_2, x)) 
    plots_3 <- lapply(indicators_3, function(x) marginsplot(df_3, x)) 
    plots_4 <- lapply(indicators_4, function(x) marginsplot(df_4, x)) 
    plots_5 <- lapply(indicators_5, function(x) marginsplot(df_5, x))
  
# Set up a figure for the legend
    forlegend <- function(data, label) {
        p <- margins%>% 
          filter(margins$short_label == label) %>%
          ggplot(aes(x = as.factor(Year), y = y_hat, color = Region)) +
          geom_point(size = 1) +
          geom_line(aes(group = Region), size = 1) +
          scale_color_manual(values = region_colors) +
          guides(color = guide_legend()) +
          theme_classic() +
          theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(),
                axis.title.y = element_text("Predicted outcome"),
                axis.text.x = element_blank(),
                plot.title = element_text(size = 8),
                legend.text = element_text(size=7),
                legend.title.align = 0,
                legend.position = "right", 
                legend.justification = "left",
                legend.direction = "horizontal",
                legend.title = element_blank()) +
          ggtitle(label) 
      print(p)
    }
  for_legend <- lapply(indicators_5, function(label) forlegend(df_5, label))
  legend <- get_legend(for_legend[[1]])
  
  # Combine the figures per indicator into a single plot per theme
    p1 <- cowplot::plot_grid(plotlist = plots_1, ncol = 3, align = 'v')
    p2 <- cowplot::plot_grid(plotlist = plots_2, ncol = 3, align = 'v')
    p3 <- cowplot::plot_grid(plotlist = plots_3, ncol = 2, align = 'v')
    p4 <- cowplot::plot_grid(plotlist = plots_4, ncol = 2, align = 'v')
    p5 <- cowplot::plot_grid(plotlist = plots_5, ncol = 2, align = 'v')
  
  # Add legend and save figure
    png(file.path(figtab_out, "SI Figure X_Theme1_trendlines.png"), width = 7.5, height = 10, unit = "in", res = 300)
      cowplot::plot_grid(p1,legend, nrow = 2, rel_heights = c(17,1), align = "hv")
      dev.off()
    png(file.path(figtab_out, "SI Figure X_Theme2_trendlines.png"), width = 7.5, height = 10, unit = "in", res = 300)
      cowplot::plot_grid(p2,legend, nrow = 2, rel_heights = c(17,1), align = "hv")
      dev.off()
    png(file.path(figtab_out, "SI Figure X_Theme3_trendlines.png"), width = 7.5, height = 10, unit = "in", res = 300)
      cowplot::plot_grid(p3,legend, nrow = 2, rel_heights = c(17,1), align = "hv")
      dev.off()
    png(file.path(figtab_out, "SI Figure X_Theme4_trendlines.png"), width = 7.5, height = 10, unit = "in", res = 300)

      }
    }


# Clean up
```

```{r, warning = FALSE, messages = FALSE, cache = TRUE}
      print(p)
    }

# Run for all indicators    
  ordered_indicators <- fct_reorder(data$short_label, data$indicator_order)
  indicators <- as.list(levels(ordered_indicators))
  lapply(indicators, function(x) plotlines(incomegroups, x, income_colors))
    
# Plot per theme - income
  n <- 1
  for (i in levels(data$theme)) {
    df <- paste0("df_", n)  
    assign(df, incomegroups %>%
             filter(theme == i) %>%
             mutate(short_label = as.factor(short_label),
                    year = as.factor(year)) %>%
             droplevels() %>%
             arrange(short_label, year, group)) 
    ordered_indicators <- fct_reorder(get(df)$short_label, get(df)$indicator_order)
    ind <- paste0("indicators_", n)  
    assign(ind, as.list(levels(ordered_indicators)))
    n <- n + 1
  }
    
  # Now run for all the indicators per theme
    plots_1 <- lapply(indicators_1, function(x) plotlines(df_1, x, income_colors)) 
    plots_2 <- lapply(indicators_2, function(x) plotlines(df_2, x, income_colors)) 
    plots_3 <- lapply(indicators_3, function(x) plotlines(df_3, x, income_colors)) 
    plots_4 <- lapply(indicators_4, function(x) plotlines(df_4, x, income_colors)) 
    plots_5 <- lapply(indicators_5, function(x) plotlines(df_5, x, income_colors))
  
# Set up a figure for the legend
  forlegend <- function(data, x, colors) {
        p <- data %>% 
          filter(short_label == x) %>%
          arrange(indicator_order, year) %>%
          ggplot(aes(x = year, y = value, group = group)) +
          geom_point(aes(color = group)) + 
          geom_line(aes(color = group), size = 0.5) + 
          scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
          guides(color = guide_legend()) +
          theme_classic() +
          theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(),
                axis.title.y = element_blank(),
                axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1),
                plot.title = element_text(size = 8),
                legend.text = element_text(size=8),
                legend.title.align = 0,
                legend.position = "right", 
                legend.justification = "left",
                legend.direction = "horizontal",
                legend.title = element_blank()) +
          ggtitle(x) 
      print(p)
  }
  for_legend <- lapply(indicators_5, function(x) forlegend(df_5, x, income_colors))
  legend <- get_legend(for_legend[[1]])
  
  # Combine the figures per indicator into a single plot per theme
    p1 <- cowplot::plot_grid(plotlist = plots_1, ncol = 3, align = 'v')
    p2 <- cowplot::plot_grid(plotlist = plots_2, ncol = 3, align = 'v')
    p3 <- cowplot::plot_grid(plotlist = plots_3, ncol = 2, align = 'v')
    p4 <- cowplot::plot_grid(plotlist = plots_4, ncol = 2, align = 'v')
    p5 <- cowplot::plot_grid(plotlist = plots_5, ncol = 2, align = 'v')
  
  # Add legend and save figure
    png(file.path(figtab_out, "SI Figure X_Theme1_income.png"), width = 7.5, height = 10, unit = "in", res = 300)
      cowplot::plot_grid(p1,legend, nrow = 2, rel_heights = c(22,1), align = "hv")
      dev.off()
    png(file.path(figtab_out, "SI Figure X_Theme2_income.png"), width = 7.5, height = 10, unit = "in", res = 300)
      cowplot::plot_grid(p2,legend, nrow = 2, rel_heights = c(22,1), align = "hv")
      dev.off()
    png(file.path(figtab_out, "SI Figure X_Theme3_income.png"), width = 7.5, height = 10, unit = "in", res = 300)
      cowplot::plot_grid(p3,legend, nrow = 2, rel_heights = c(22,1), align = "hv")
      dev.off()
    png(file.path(figtab_out, "SI Figure X_Theme4_income.png"), width = 7.5, height = 10, unit = "in", res = 300)
      cowplot::plot_grid(p4,legend, nrow = 2, rel_heights = c(22,1), align = "hv")
      dev.off()
    png(file.path(figtab_out, "SI Figure X_Theme5_income.png"), width = 7.5, height = 10, unit = "in", res = 300)
      cowplot::plot_grid(p5,legend, nrow = 2, rel_heights = c(22,1), align = "hv")
      dev.off()

  # Clean up
    rm(incomegroups, data, for_legend, indicators, legend)
    for (i in 1:5) {
      if (exists(paste0("df_", i))) {
        rm(list = paste0("df_", i), envir = .GlobalEnv)
      }
     if (exists(paste0("plots_", i))) {
        rm(list = paste0("plots_", i), envir = .GlobalEnv)
      }
      if (exists(paste0("indicators_", i))) {
        rm(list = paste0("indicators_", i), envir = .GlobalEnv)
      }
      if (exists(paste0("p", i))) {
        rm(list = paste0("p", i), envir = .GlobalEnv)
      }
    }

```

#### Supplementary Data 1: Metadata and Codebook Latest data point per indicator
This code creates the table that lists the latest data point per country-indicator pair
```{r, warning = FALSE, messages = FALSE, echo = TRUE}
  # Latest data point
    latest_df <- FSCI_2025 %>%
      filter(!(is.na(value))) %>%
      group_by(country, indicator) %>%
      mutate(maxyear = max(year)) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      filter(year == maxyear) %>%
      sort_by(country ~ indicator_order) 

  # To fix indicator column ordering
    indicator_order <- latest_df %>% 
      select(c(short_label, indicator_order)) %>%
      unique()
    # Create a complete list by country
    complete_grid <- latest_df %>%
      select(c(country)) %>% unique()
    complete_grid <- merge(complete_grid, indicator_order) %>%
      arrange(country, indicator_order)
    
    for_metadata <- latest_df %>%
      select(c(1,5,9)) 
    for_metadata <- left_join(complete_grid, for_metadata, by = c("country", "short_label"))

  for_metadata <- for_metadata %>%
    select(-c(indicator_order)) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = short_label, values_from = year) %>%
    mutate(across(c(2:58), as.character),
           across(c(2:58), na_if, "NA"))
  writexl::write_xlsx(for_metadata, file.path(data_out, "Latest data point per country-indicator.xlsx"))
  # This sheet is manually added to Supplementary Data 1 - Metadata and Codebook 
```
